title: Dentsu Enters Partnership with Kodansha
content: Variety reported on Friday that major Japanese advertising firm Dentsu is entering a partnership with Kodansha Ltd. that will give potential clients in North and South America access to several Kodansha intellectual properties (IPs) including Attack on Titan , Ghost in the Shell , and Blue Lock .

title: One Piece Anime's First 325 Episodes Stream on Crunchyroll in India
content: Crunchyroll began streaming the anime's Elbaph arc in India on April 5. The Elbaph arc debuted in Japan on April 5. Netflix is streaming the arc in India as well. Crunchyroll will stream the English dub of the arc (from episode 1156) in India beginning on October 20.
author: ANN
